description: Retired USAF Thunderbirds F-16 unveiled on a plaza in front of the school on 25 April 2026 and the first retired Thunderbird jet given to an American high school; visible from Interstate 70; the aircraft cost about 55000 dollars with roughly 30000 to 40000 dollars of plaza construction and 15000 dollars endowed for perpetual care; the school teams are the Union Local Jets which is why the community pursued it for sixty years; a single compilation gives the serial as 87-0329 but none of the extensive news coverage confirms it so the tail number is left blank rather than asserted
aliases: Fighting Falcon; Viper; Thunderbird; 87-0329; F16; F16C
